about: Labels something with one short word or a count, set off from what it labels.

corners.about: Every corner at every size, on a count. Numbers are tabular, so a column of counts holds its width as the counts change.
corners.title: Corners and sizes

looks.about: Every look at every size. The look is flat, so a badge does not repaint under a pointer.
looks.title: Looks and sizes

statuses.about: Every status in every look. A badge whose meaning is in its colour needs that meaning in words.
statuses.title: Statuses

title: Badge
